Name: SESSION_REWARD_BY_MODE_RANK_PARAM_ST
Description: End-of-expedition reward settings by game mode: row 1000 (mode 0), row 2000 (mode 1) and rows 5100-5500 (Deep of Night depth 1-5). Holds the Murk multipliers, the victory Sovereign Sigils and the reward item lots.

Fields.Name: Murk Multiplier - Index 0
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the expedition's Murk (base + statistics) when the expedition's reward index is 0. Ten multipliers (Index 0-9) are chosen by that index; what the index represents is not established. Retail: 0.8 (mode 0), 0 (mode 1), 1.47-2.41 (Deep of Night).

Fields.Name: Murk Multiplier - Index 7
Fields.Description: As Index 0, for reward index 7. Retail: the only non-zero rate of mode 1 (1.3).

Fields.Name: Murk Multiplier - Special Session
Fields.Description: Replaces the indexed multiplier when the session's special flag is set: in Deep of Night always, in mode 0 only when the expedition was not won. What sets the flag is not established. Retail 1.3 (mode 0).

Fields.Name: Victory Sovereign Sigils
Fields.Description: Sovereign Sigils for a won Deep of Night expedition at this depth, when the session's special flag is set; the Extra Sigil chances of SessionRewardCommonParam are added. Retail 8, 10, 12, 15, 18 for depth 1-5.

Fields.Name: Reward Item Lot - Stage 0-1
Fields.Description: Item lot given for an expedition that ended at progress stage 0 or 1.

Fields.Name: Reward Item Lot - Stage 2-3
Fields.Description: Item lot given for an expedition that ended at progress stage 2 or 3.

Fields.Name: Reward Item Lot - Stage 4
Fields.Description: Item lot given for an expedition that ended at progress stage 4 without victory.

Fields.Name: Reward Item Lot - Victory
Fields.Description: Item lot given for a won expedition.

Fields.Name: Murk Multiplier - Index 8
Fields.Description: As Index 0, for reward index 8. Retail 1.15 in mode 0.

Fields.Name: Murk Multiplier - Index 9
Fields.Description: As Index 0, for reward index 9. Retail 1.3 in mode 0.
